title: [chore][cmd/mdatagen] Allow private fields in mdatagen-generated configs
body:
<!--Ex. Fixing a bug - Describe the bug and how this fixes the issue.
Ex. Adding a feature - Explain what this achieves.-->
#### Description

Add support for private fields in `mdatagen`-generated configuration structs.

When `go_struct.private_fields` is enabled in `metadata.yaml`, the generated struct embeds a package-private `private<Type>Fields` type. This allows component-specific implementation fields to be defined outside the generated file without exposing them through the configuration schema.

<!--Describe what testing was performed and which tests were added.-->
#### Testing

- Added unit tests for the new `private_fields` metadata option.
- Added generator tests verifying private field embedding.
- Added sample scraper coverage for generated private fields.
